package.name: cits_integration
package.description: Data-integration node: subscribes to fake_rsu's JSON C-ITS messages (CAM/DENM/SPAT) and converts/fuses them into Autoware Universe perception messages (DetectedObjects, TrafficLightGroupArray). Stands in for a dedicated Adapter node for now; a perception_ai_node input can be added later once its output contract is defined.
